The `steady` ledger with comment rows added: rows with an empty `type` are comments (DESIGN 3.4). A dated comment (`2026-07-13T09:00, carol took over from bob here`) sorts at its instant, first among the rows there. An undated comment takes the instant of the next dated row below it when the ledger is read and stays directly above that instant: the header comment stays above the `set` row; the comment written above the generated 09-21 shift stays above the 09-21 shift although that shift is pruned and regenerated, which is what a "swap this one" note needs; the comment written above the old `snapshot` row keeps the 08-31 instant and ends up above the 08-31 shift once the snapshot moves to 09-07. The comment whose `start` is `someday` counts as undated and, having only the trailing comment below it, trails at the end together with it; `#Status` warns about its row (`expected/status.txt`). Comments are ignored by validation, replay, generation and the `#All shifts` view, so the shifts and the snapshot are identical to `steady`; the second run of the golden test shows that every comment stays where the first run put it.
